attributes.title: Yankee Dental Congress 2027
attributes.venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center (MCEC)
attributes.summary:
Yankee Dental Congress 2027 takes place January 28 to 30, 2027, at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center in Boston. Registration covers all three days and the exhibit floor; many lectures and hands-on courses are ticketed separately, and some exhibit-floor CE is free with expo access.

The Massachusetts Dental Society is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider. Registration itself carries general attendance credit (5 for dentists, 4 for hygienists, 3 for assistants); course hours are added on top. Hygienists get a dedicated full-day "Hygiene Experience" on Friday, January 29.

Fees step up in three phases: First Call until October 30, 2026, General until December 28, 2026, and Final Call through onsite. An ADA member dentist pays $140, $170 or $200; a hygienist $85, $110 or $140.
